core_problem_solved: To provide a Java-based template engine that allows for a clean separation of presentation (the HTML, SQL, or other text output) from business logic (the Java code).
key_features: A simple but powerful template language (VTL - Velocity Template Language)
Ability to render templates with data from a Java 'context' object
Can be used for generating web pages, SQL queries, emails, or any other text-based format
era_and_niche: A very popular and influential template engine in the early days of Java web development (early 2000s), particularly in the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architectural pattern before JSP and JSF became dominant.
reason_for_obsolescence: While **not strictly obsolete** (the project saw a modern revival as 'Velocity Engine'), its popularity has significantly declined. In the web space, it was largely superseded by frameworks like JSP/JSTL, and later by more modern template engines like **Thymeleaf** (especially in the Spring ecosystem) or client-side JavaScript rendering. For general-purpose templating, alternatives like FreeMarker or StringTemplate also exist.
